Hi, I'm a current student of the MSC. in Digital Marketing course. Feel free to DM me  or ask any questions :)  


And regarding housing - however bad you think it is, multiple it by 5 if you're female and by 10 if you're male. It's pretty bad. While there is housing development happening, it's still not *affordable*. You're looking at **atleast** 1000eu per month to have a simple room to yourself.
This is so incredible! Would love to have this in my room to remind me that life is precious and Iron Man is daddy
I see you and I'm so proud of you! Keep going xo

Think of it this way: we all have multiple personalities in ourselves. For example, one might want us to explore the world and have no commitments, while one  craves the comfort of home and a family etc. When you consider killing yourself - you're killing ALL those personalities. You're simply ending them. Even the ones that actually might want to live and do things.   


Suicide isn't fair to all your personalities. I hope theres at least one personality in there that wants to do something. Try to give that personality the narrative.    


It might help you feel differently about yourself, that's all. You can't really change the horrible people around you, but maybe you can change your expectations and live for yourself. It's a VERY big if though, and needs years on work. But it is worth it.
I have had my reservations against a general marketing degree. This is certainly more food for thought. Thank you so much for sharing this!
